title: Germantown district releases leadership profile for superintendent search
text:
Schools
Germantown district releases leadership profile for superintendent search
Germantown School District says search firm HYA has completed a leadership profile to guide its superintendent search.
Germantown School District announced Wednesday, Oct. 28, that its search firm partner, Hazard, Young, Attea and Associates, has completed and presented a District Leadership Profile based on community feedback, according to the district.
The district said the profile is part of an ongoing search for the district's next superintendent and reflects input gathered through focus groups, surveys and listening sessions. HYA asked each group the same core questions, focusing on what participants value in the district and the challenges it faces, the district said.
According to the district, the engagement process identified several strengths, including a welcoming environment, dedicated staff who go "above and beyond" for students, and students who feel prepared for life after high school.
The process also identified areas for growth, the district said. These include a need for increased trust and transparency from the board and administration, concerns about staff retention amid competition from neighboring districts, and a desire for greater assurance that student needs are prioritized in budget decisions, even though financial management was seen as strong.
The district quoted an unnamed theme from the report stating that "Perception becomes reality," to describe how community perceptions of leadership can affect morale.
The district said the search process will continue, with the school board focused on listening to and acting on community feedback as it selects a new superintendent. An HYA presenter told the district, "You're a great school district, and you have a lot to be proud of."
The district said more information on the superintendent search process and timeline, along with HYA's full District Leadership report, is available on its website.
Source: Germantown School District, https://www.gsdwi.org/article/3219462
